annotations.title: Change Login, roles and waiting lists

description: Changes access: your own JWT login provider, group roles, groups users create, waiting lists (closed beta, limited seats or product units) and the consent-screen sentence per SSO scope. Waits in the draft until neblla_promote "save" (env "pro" for the users). permissionJustificationsI18n applies at once. More: neblla_get_llms tools/update_app_auth

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

auth.description: Your login provider's JWTs (BYOAuth): { issuer, audience, jwksUrl? } or a list; null clears it.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

groups.description: Groups the users make themselves: { clientCreate, creatorRole, maxMembers, invitable }; null turns them off.

permissionJustifications.description: Why the app asks each SSO scope (email, friends, discoverable), shown on the consent screen; not browser permissions.

permissionJustificationsI18n.description: The same per language: { <scope>: { <lang>: text } }; applies at once.

roles.description: Roles for groups and their rights per table (neblla_group); null clears them.

waitlists.description: Whole list, replaces it (≤10): [{ id, state, seats, gatesLogin, … }]; "open" admits up to seats, the rest queue; "waitlist": invitees only; null clears.
